name: io.github.sekera-radim/briefgate
title: BriefGate
description: Client intake for AI agents: get files, copy and logins from clients, chased automatically.

environmentVariables.name: BRIEFGATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: BriefGate API key (bg_live_... or bg_test_...). Optional: run `npx -y @briefgate/mcp login` once to sign in without one.

environmentVariables.name: BRIEFGATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL override for staging or local development. Defaults to https://api.briefgate.dev.
